items.question: Why isn’t the vegetable soup on your lunch menu Eig w today? au
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Why isn’t the vegetable soup on your lunch menu Eig w today? au”，自然应答是“We're offering French onion soup.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（We're offering French onion soup.）。
